title: LIHEAP - federal framework
facts: LIHEAP provides federal funding to states, territories and tribes to help eligible low-income households with home energy costs.
LIHEAP is not a single nationwide entitlement with one benefit amount; administering agencies set program details within federal rules and available funding.
Assistance can include heating or cooling help, crisis assistance, weatherization-related services or other allowed energy assistance depending on the local program.
Applicants generally apply through their state, tribal or territorial LIHEAP program.
